title: openai-curated-render-deploy
summary: --- name: render-deploy description: Deploy applications to Render by analyzing codebases, generating render.yaml Blueprints, and providing Dashboard deeplinks. Use when the user wants to deploy, host, publish, or set up their application on Render's cloud platform. --- # Deploy to Render Render supports **Git-backed** services and **prebuilt Docker image** services. This skill covers **Git-backed** flows: 1. **Blueprint Method** - Generate render.yaml for Infrastructure-as-Code deployments 2. **Direct Creation** - Create services instantly via MCP tools Blueprints can also run a **prebuilt Docker image** by using `runtime: image`, but the `render.yaml` still must live in a Git repo.
type: skills
tags: openai, source-openai-skills
